{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (1.0), forecast prices are too low - increase by ~3-5% to capture genuine demand-driven momentum",
    "When current price is below the 7-day moving average, model lacks enough lag recognition - align initial forecast points with recent price level",
    "For out-of-sample days (beyond 7 days), forecasts converge too slowly to mean - apply 80% scaling factor on day 8+ to prevent persistent overshoot",
    "When sentiment turns negative (-0.33 to -0.67), model doesn't discount fast enough - flatten forecast by 15-20% from model baseline",
    "The model's volatility is 40% too low compared to true outcomes - apply 1.4x multiplicative scaling to all forecast points",
    "Sentiment strength correlates with forecast deviation - when sentiment magnitude is strong (0.67+), adjust corresponding forecast segments by 10-15% from model values",
    "Recent price acceleration (>0.5% daily) isn't captured - when 3+ day price trend is up, lift adjacent forecast points toward true trajectory"
] }
